full_prompt_en: The image is a square polished oil painting of a dark-haired woman in profile among white blossoms inside an ornate round frame. The circular opening occupies most of the square, with a brown-gold border carved in repeating floral scrolls and narrow concentric bands. Inside it, a deep turquoise background sets off the woman's pale face and warm terracotta drapery. She turns to the right and slightly downward, her dark eyes directed toward a small spray of white roses at the lower right. Dense black-brown hair is gathered high at the back in curling masses, with a few loose strands near the temple and a small pale blossom tucked into the rear. Her cheek carries a gentle warm blush; the straight nose and softly closed red lips are modeled with smooth transitions rather than strong contour lines. A thin strap and layered rust-orange cloth cross the near shoulder and fall toward the lower edge of the circle. More white blossoms and muted green leaves appear at the left behind her hair, while the right spray rises on slender stems. Several thin vertical reddish lines cross the teal ground, adding quiet structure behind the figure. The viewpoint is close and level, cropping the torso so the profile and floral details dominate. Warm soft light from the upper left brightens the face, neck, and petals, while dark hair and the engraved frame hold deeper shadow. The painted surface is smooth in skin, more textured in the carved ring and leaf clusters. The composition is calm and decorative, balancing the warm profile and drapery against cool turquoise and the circular rhythm of the frame.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、打磨细致的油画：一位深发女子侧身立在华丽圆框内的白花之间。圆形开口占据方形画幅大部，棕金色边框刻着重复花草卷饰和窄同心带。框内深青绿背景衬出女子浅脸与暖陶土色垂布。她转向右并略低头，暗眼望向右下方一小枝白玫瑰。浓密黑棕头发在后面高高盘成卷团，鬓边有几缕散发，后部别着一小朵浅花。脸颊带温和暖红晕；直鼻和柔合的红唇以平滑过渡塑形，而非强轮廓线。一条细肩带和层叠锈橙布横过近处肩膀，落向圆框下缘。左侧头发后还有白花与低饱和绿叶，右侧花枝沿细茎升起。几道细红褐竖线穿过青绿底，在人物身后增添安静结构。视点贴近且平视，裁掉躯干，让侧影与花饰主导。左上方暖柔光照亮面孔、颈和花瓣，暗发与刻纹框保留更深阴影。肤色颜料平滑，雕刻圆环与叶团则较有纹理。构图平静而装饰性强，让暖侧影与垂布对着冷青绿及框的圆形节奏保持平衡。
style_prompt_en: Polished oil painting combines smooth luminous modeling with precise decorative texture. A richly patterned brown-gold circular border contains a cool saturated teal field; warm terracotta and pale cream shapes create the main contrast inside it. Soft upper light rounds the central focal volume, while dark brown-black masses and engraved recesses provide weight. Fine curling linework and small ivory accents punctuate the flatter cool ground. Edges of the focal form are gentle and continuous, but border details remain crisp and repetitive. The crop is close and shallow, with depth carried by overlap, color temperature, and selective texture. The overall rhythm is poised, circular, and ornate without losing the quiet central shape.
style_prompt_zh: 细致油画把平滑明亮塑形与准确装饰纹理结合。花纹丰厚的棕金圆形边界包住饱和冷青绿场，暖陶土和浅奶油色形体在里面形成主要对比。上方柔光使中央焦点体积圆润，深棕黑色块与刻纹凹处提供重量。细卷线与小象牙色点缀刺破较平的冷色底。焦点形体边缘温和连续，边框细节却清脆且重复。裁幅贴近、空间浅，纵深由遮叠、色温和选择性肌理承载。整体节奏端庄、环形而华丽，却没有丢失安静的中央大形。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman in profile among white blossoms inside an ornate round frame
theme_zh: 一位深发女子侧身立在华丽圆框内的白花之间
name: John William Godward
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
